p: defiled for the dead among his: By touching the dead, lamenting, or being at their burial.
virgin: For being married she seemed to be cut off from his family.
chief man among his people: The priest was permitted to mourn for his next kindred only.
profane: Which has an evil name or is defamed.
sanctify him therefore: You shall count them holy and reverence them.
bread of thy God: The showbread.
uncover his head: He shall use no such ceremonies as the mourners observed.
sanctuary: To go to the dead.
crown of the anointing oil of: For by his anointing he was preferred above the other priests and therefore could not lament the dead, least he should have polluted his holy anointing.
people to wife: Not only of his tribe, but of all Israel.
seed among his people: By marrying any unchaste or defamed woman.
a flat nose: Which is deformed or bruised.
thing superfluous: As not of equal proportion, or having in number more or less.
or that hath a blemish in: Or that has a web or pearl.
bread of his God: As the show bread, and meat offerings.
most holy: As of sacrifice for sin.
of the holy: As of the tithes and first fruits.
